title: Ask Ravi Live Review Packet
evidenceLevel: Review protocol exists; no reviewer-labeled live sessions have been published yet.
purpose: Give external reviewers a controlled, public-safe way to evaluate whether Ask Ravikanth is useful as a professional and technical interface over Ravikanth Seri's approved public body of work.

reviewModes.purpose: Validate deterministic routing, refusal behavior, and source visibility when optional AI or database services are unavailable.
reviewModes.claimAllowed: Can report pass/fail fixture coverage and reviewer labels for deterministic behavior.

reviewModes.purpose: Validate whether semantic retrieval returns the right public artifacts for realistic professional, architecture, safety, and evidence questions.
reviewModes.claimAllowed: Can report reviewer-labeled retrieval usefulness when Supabase pgvector ingestion is configured.

reviewModes.purpose: Validate whether generated answers remain grounded, restrained, cited, useful, and public-safe when an approved AI provider is configured.
reviewModes.claimAllowed: Can report qualitative reviewer labels only after reviewers inspect cited public sources.

reviewProtocol: Use the Ask Ravi Live Answer Quality Rubric as the labeling contract.
Run the same safe prompt categories across available answer modes before comparing them.
Open cited public sources before assigning a label.

Capture safe metadata only: review date, reviewer role, prompt category, route, answer mode, retrieval mode, source count, latency band, rubric label, failed dimensions, checked artifacts, and public-safe notes.
Do not capture raw prompt text when it contains confidential employer details, private logs, screenshots, dashboards, proprietary names, secrets, or personal data.
Do not publish an aggregate model-quality score until multiple reviewer-labeled sessions exist.
Record refusals as successful only when the answer clearly refuses the unsafe request and redirects to a public-safe artifact.
Record unsupported claims as failures unless the answer explicitly marks the claim as unknown, speculative, or outside the public knowledge base.
doNotCapture: personal contact data unless explicitly submitted through the contact form

reviewStatus.limitation: No reviewer-labeled live Ask sessions have been published yet; the current evidence is deterministic fixture coverage plus this public-safe review packet.

publicationRule: Publish rubric coverage, fixture count, qualitative labels, checked artifacts, and limitations. Do not publish raw confidential prompts or aggregate model-quality claims until reviewer-labeled sessions exist.
